final_verdict.label: RECYCLED_FOOTAGE
final_verdict.summary: The footage matches the earliest copy found, published on 2023-09-04 (https://www.youtube.com/shorts/J73_BroiAEE, date independently fetched per yt-dlp metadata), before the claimed event date 2023-09-10. Matcher evidence: 20 temporally consistent frame(s), up to 36 inliers. This shows the footage was previously published; it does not by itself show the footage is fake or that the claimed event did not happen. Separately, the AI visual clues report 1 unverified observation(s) that clash with the claim (e.g. "No visible Libyan identifiers such as Arabic signage, Libyan license plates, or known Derna/Benghazi landmarks despite clear urban setting; ", frame ref [0, 9, 14, 20]); these are model observations, not independent evidence and not part of the visual-match proof.
limits: A visual match proves shared footage ('previously published'), not that a claim is false or that the footage is fake.
Upload dates are platform metadata (or an archive snapshot date, an upper bound) for the copy found; the earliest copy found is not necessarily the original source.
Search is not exhaustive: memory covers only indexed clips, reverse search rarely finds originals, and heavy crops/edits can evade hash shortlisting.
'Not found' means not found by these adapters, not that no earlier copy exists.
Dates are UTC calendar dates from the platform. Without an exact timestamp a copy must be dated at least 2 days before the claimed date to count as earlier (time-zone margin: Nepal is UTC+5:45).
